def immutable(fn):
    arrays = [A.copy(), U.copy(), V.copy(), P.copy()]
    before = [array.copy() for array in arrays]
    for array in arrays:
        array.setflags(write=False)
    result = np.asarray(fn(*arrays, dz, gamma))
    assert result.shape == (2 * N + 1, N)
    assert np.iscomplexobj(result) and np.isfinite(result).all()
    assert all(np.array_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(arrays, before))
    return result
assert np.allclose(
immutable(qssf_coupled_step)
, target)

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm


def check(fn, covariance):
    result = np.asarray(fn(covariance.copy()))
    n = len(covariance) // 2
    assert result.shape == (2 * n + 1, 2 * n)
    assert np.isrealobj(result) and np.isfinite(result).all()
    if n == 0:
        return np.array([0.0])
    diagonal, W = result[0], result[1:]
    nu = diagonal[:n]
    omega = np.block(
        [
            [np.zeros((n, n)), np.eye(n)],
            [-np.eye(n), np.zeros((n, n))],
        ]
    )
    error_cov = np.linalg.norm(W @ covariance @ W.T - np.diag(diagonal)) / max(
        1.0, np.linalg.norm(diagonal)
    )
    error_symp = np.linalg.norm(W @ omega @ W.T - omega) / (2 * n)
    valid = (
        np.allclose(diagonal[n:], nu, rtol=0, atol=1e-10)
        and np.all(np.diff(nu) <= 1e-10)
        and np.min(nu) >= 0.5 - 1e-10
        and error_cov <= 1e-8
        and error_symp <= 1e-8
    )
    return np.concatenate((nu, [0.0 if valid else 1.0]))

    assert result.shape == (2 * n + 1, 2 * n)
    assert np.isrealobj(result) and np.isfinite(result).all()
    if n == 0:
        return np.array([0.0])
    diagonal, W = result[0], result[1:]
    nu = diagonal[:n]
    omega = np.block(
        [
            [np.zeros((n, n)), np.eye(n)],
            [-np.eye(n), np.zeros((n, n))],
        ]
    )
    error_cov = np.linalg.norm(W @ covariance @ W.T - np.diag(diagonal)) / max(
        1.0, np.linalg.norm(diagonal)
    )
    error_symp = np.linalg.norm(W @ omega @ W.T - omega) / (2 * n)
    valid = (
        np.allclose(diagonal[n:], nu, rtol=0, atol=1e-10)
        and np.all(np.diff(nu) <= 1e-10)
        and np.min(nu) >= 0.5 - 1e-10
        and error_cov <= 1e-8
        and error_symp <= 1e-8
    )
    return np.concatenate((nu, [0.0 if valid else 1.0]))
